preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_j <= n and 1 <= a_j <= 10**9 and 1 <= b_j <= 10**9 for p_j, a_j, b_j in edges)

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n-1 integers for each test case.

postconditions.description: Each r_i must be a non-negative integer not exceeding the length of the path from the root to vertex i.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(b_j for b_j in path[:r_i]) <= sum(a_j for a_j in path) for r_i, path in zip(results, paths))
postconditions.description: For each r_i, the sum of b_j along the prefix of length r_i must not exceed the sum of a_j along the path to vertex i.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(b_j for b_j in path[:r_i]) <= sum(a_j for a_j in path) and (r_i == len(path) or sum(b_j for b_j in path[:r_i + 1]) > sum(a_j for a_j in path)) for r_i, path in zip(results, paths))
